newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Rate assured in Portugal euro-denominated bond.
newsitem.headline: Rate assured in Portugal euro-denominated bond.

text.p: A 10-year 50 billion escudos Portuguese government loan that can be converted into euros has a conversion rate that in the worst case will be identical to the present ecu rate, a source in the Finance Ministry said.
"The conversion rate will be the best of the effective rate (at the launch of the euro) or the present (ecu) rate," the source told Reuters.

The Finance Ministry said earlier that the government had authorised the Institute of Management of Public Credit to issue a 10-year loan in escudos for up to 50 billion escudos that can be automatically re-denominated in euros at the launch of EMU.
